subject: Error when installing new version of stan

messages.author: ace9745b50e86915
messages.subject: Error when installing new version of stan
parts:
Hi! Hope you have a great holiday.

Maybe this is a silly question because I haven't tried to install stan for long... But today after I used the command-line access to get the newest version

git clone https://code.google.com/p/stan/

I cannot successfully make the library using the command

make bin/libstan.a

 (I am supposed to make the library and the model parser and code generator before proceeding to compile models, right?)

the error is as follows:

i686-apple-darwin11-llvm-g++-4.2: src/stan/model/model_header.hpp: linker input file unused because linking not done
g++ -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.2 -I lib/boost_1.52.0 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -Wno-unused-function   -c -o bin/stan/agrad/agrad.o src/stan/agrad/agrad.cpp
In file included from src/stan/agrad/agrad.cpp:4:
src/stan/agrad/agrad.hpp:348: error: ISO C++ does not support ‘long long’
src/stan/agrad/agrad.hpp:358: error: ISO C++ does not support ‘long long’
src/stan/agrad/agrad.hpp: In constructor ‘stan::agrad::<unnamed>::op_vector_vari::op_vector_vari(double, const std::vector<stan::agrad::var, std::allocator<stan::agrad::var> >&)’:
src/stan/agrad/agrad.hpp:757: error: ISO C++ forbids variable-size array
src/stan/agrad/agrad.hpp: At global scope:
src/stan/agrad/agrad.hpp:1665: warning: unused parameter ‘dummy’
src/stan/agrad/agrad.hpp:1702: warning: unused parameter ‘dummy’
make: *** [bin/stan/agrad/agrad.o] Error 1

Without making the library, I cannot run the basic model with "make src/models/basic_estimators/bernoulli" and the error is very long...

Could you help me figure out what's wrong with the installation. Thank you very much.

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error when installing new version of stan
parts:
It is just that -pedantic was added to the makefile.  I push a change to leave that out.  Please do 'git pull' to get that change, you should be fine to go. 

--
Jiqiang

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Error when installing new version of stan
parts: It is a compiler flag: for example, it is in the output you have posted.

g++ -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.2 -I lib/boost_1.52.0 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -Wno-unused-function   -c -o bin/stan/agrad/agrad.o src/stan/agrad/agrad.cpp

See the manual of gcc or http://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gcc-4.7.2/gcc/Warning-Options.html
--
Jiqiang
